Solar PV servicing

Gold, Platinum, Diamond.

Annual servicing packages to suit different needs, with fixed annual subscription pricing or one-off callout pricing. Ask for your price.

Battery storage: supplied, fitted and maintained for domestic and commercial customers. Retrofit, new installation or extra capacity, plus Solar PV upgrades to support it.

Package 1Gold

Inspection of the AC isolators, DC isolators, solar inverter and AC circuit.

Package 2Platinum

Everything in Gold, plus inspection of the strings and panels for any damage or overheating.*

Package 3Diamond

Everything in Platinum, plus full array cleaning and an inverter settings review so the array generates at its best.*

* Subject to terms.

Surveys

See the roof before the scaffold.

Drones with ultra high definition cameras inspect solar PV, high-level electrical equipment and hard-to-reach areas, so clients can avoid costly access equipment.

  • Aerial surveys. Standard or Advanced packages, in all weathers.
  • Thermal surveys. Roofs, equipment and search and rescue.
  • Visual and electrical surveys. Standard and thermal, to plan maintenance and find faults early.
Specialist works

Cable, fobs and specialist kit.

Access fob cloning

A mobile duplication system for Stanley/PAC, Noralsey, Impro and many more. Fobs, cards and buttons can all be copied, programmed on site.

£45 + VAT per fob

£20 + VAT per fob if ordered with other works. Ask for multiple fob pricing.

MICC (pyro) cable

Mineral Insulated Copper Conductor cable is now a specialist skill. ElectriServe has installed and repaired it for years on projects and callouts.

Thorlux SmartScan

Contract packages for out-of-warranty SmartScan lighting systems, repaired with genuine Thorlux parts.

Welding and physical security

Design and build solutions across client sites. A site survey comes first so the price is accurate.

Electrical project management

Save time, money and stress on projects of any size, with remote packages or site and stakeholder visits.

Working with insurers

Repair works for insurers, and estimates from a complete rewire to a switch change.

Air conditioning partnership

Two firms, one install.

ElectriServe has teamed up with Kentish Air Conditioning Ltd, a REFCOM registered HVAC company covering domestic and commercial systems. Ask Kentish for air conditioning prices and bookings.

The electrical side stays with ElectriServe: installed and signed off to NICEIC standards.
